response.original_title: Com uma câmera na mão e uma máscara de gás na cara
response.overview: With images captured during the protests of June 2013 in Rio de Janeiro, the film presents people who actively participated in the movement. A photographer, a ninja, a recent graduate of journalism, a film reporter and a young filmmaker share their opinions about a particular moment in the country’s recent history.
